'''C-Family Protocol torsos''' were parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] made by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. They were traditional [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]]-style torsos. The torsos were made of [[Copper/Legends|copper]], [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] and [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]], and the material composition was not conducive for magnetism. They had medium-to-low material durability and weighed 37.0 [[Kilogram/Legends|kg]].

These torsos were part of the famous [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]].
